Field trials run by the Dunmere Agricultural Station showed that sorghum and drought-tolerant cowpea produced harvests even when rainfall fell 35% below normal. Yet seed of these varieties is not sold by any agro-dealer in the county, and extension officers cover areas of more than 400 square kilometres each. This project will establish community seed banks in 15 villages and train lead farmers to multiply and distribute improved seed.

Our technical partner believes the gateway, not the network, was at fault. We have never conducted a drill at night, and the committee recommends one before the cyclone season begins in November.

The Haven Rights Collective has provided case management in the camp since 2019, focusing on unaccompanied minors, survivors of violence and older persons living alone. In the last twelve months, caseworkers registered 2,300 new protection cases, yet only nine caseworkers are currently employed. As a result, many families did not receive a follow-up visit within the required 14 days. Referral pathways to legal aid exist, but they are not consistently used because transport to the district court is unavailable. This proposal seeks funding to recruit six additional caseworkers and establish a weekly mobile legal clinic inside the camp.

Caregivers made an average of six home visits per client each month, exceeding the target of four. Clients reported that caregivers helped them collect antiretroviral refills and reminded them of clinic appointments. Viral load suppression among enrolled clients rose to 78 percent, compared with 59 percent at baseline. However, the stipend system was not functioning as designed, and several caregivers had gone two months without payment. The evaluators recommend that the programme should never rely on a single disbursement channel.

source_passage: The semi-arid plains of Kordessa County have recorded below-average rainfall in four of the last six years, and the 2022 long rains failed almost entirely. Most of the county's 28,000 farming households still plant a single local maize variety that does not tolerate dry spells longer than ten days. Field trials run by the Dunmere Agricultural Station showed that sorghum and drought-tolerant cowpea produced harvests even when rainfall fell 35% below normal. Yet seed of these varieties is not sold by any agro-dealer in the county, and extension officers cover areas of more than 400 square kilometres each. This project will establish community seed banks in 15 villages and train lead farmers to multiply and distribute improved seed.
quote: Most of the county's 28,000 farming households still plant a single local maize variety that does not tolerate dry spells longer than twenty days.

No group reported losing funds to theft, which members credited to the three-key lockbox system. Graduation of groups to independent status was slower than planned, and 46 groups did not complete their share-out on schedule. Field officers also noted that young men were rarely joining.
